ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Python DLL SideLoading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of Python DLL files. Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded, Signed

sequences.query: (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\python39\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\python310\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\python311\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\python312\\\.dll$")) AND  NOT (((ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Python3") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Python3")) OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Programs\\\\Python\\\\Python3.*")) OR (process_product = "Python" AND Signed = "true" AND process_description = "Python" AND process_company = "Python\ Software\ Foundation")) AND  NOT (ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Visual\\ Studio\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Anaconda3\\\\") OR (ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\cpython\\\\externals\\\\.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\cpython\\\\PCbuild\\\\.*")) OR (ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Users") AND ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\\\_MEI.*")))
